chunks: A man came to ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام and said: “You have preferred hajj over jihad, while Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has said:”
“Indeed, Allah has purchased from the believers their lives and their wealth in exchange for Paradise.”
up to its end. Then ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام said to him: “Then read what comes after it.” So he said:
“Those who repent, those who worship, those who praise…”
until he reached the end of the verse. He said: “When you see these people, then jihad with them on that day is more excellent than hajj.”

key_terms.التَّائِبُونَ: those who repent and return to Allah
key_terms.الْجِهَادِ: jihad, striving in the path of Allah
key_terms.الْحَجَّ: hajj, the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the believers, those characterized by faith

ai.seo_question: When is jihad better than hajj according to Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام?
ai.summary: Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام directs the questioner to read the full Qur'anic passage, showing that the merit of jihad is tied to the presence of specific spiritual qualities among those engaged in it. The report highlights careful Qur'anic reading and indicates that hajj may be preferable when those conditions are not found.
